\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 219-220 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R222-first-pass-words-from-chapters-219-220}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for literature and a merchant.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a hose, wood, glass, copper, silk
  \item a card, a loan, goods, an account, a butcher
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A hose? (\textbf{\ar{خرطوم}}, \emph{kharṭūm}.) Wood? (\textbf{\ar{خشب}}, \emph{khashab}.) Glass? (\textbf{\ar{زجاج}}, \emph{zujāj}.) Copper? (\textbf{\ar{نحاس}}, \emph{nuḥās}.) Silk? (\textbf{\ar{حرير}}, \emph{ḥarīr}.) A card? (\textbf{\ar{بطاقة}}, \emph{biṭāqa}.) A loan? (\textbf{\ar{قرض}}, \emph{qarḍ}.) Goods? (\textbf{\ar{بضاعة}}, \emph{biḍāʿa}.) An account? (\textbf{\ar{حساب}}, \emph{ḥisāb}.) A butcher? (\textbf{\ar{جزار}}, \emph{jazzār}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
